segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּבָרִים נֶאֶמְרוּ בַּצִּפׇּרְנַיִם: שׂוֹרְפָן — חָסִיד, קוֹבְרָן — צַדִּיק, זוֹרְקָן — רָשָׁע.
segments.en: With regard to removing one’s nails, «the Sages taught: Three matters were stated with regard to» removing «nails:» One who «burns them» is «pious,» as he eradicates them entirely; one who «buries them» is on the slightly lower level of «a righteous» individual, as they might be dug up; and one who simply «throws them» where a person might step upon them is «wicked.»
